title: Book Two · Chapter 166: Four Marks
story:
On Monday, the practice record goes on the reading room wall. Ronan waits behind two other students. He expects to find three marks beside his name.

There are four.

He reads the row again. The first, third, and fifth tasks have marks for good independent results. The second has no mark. The sixth box has a note about a correction.

The fourth task has a good independent mark too.

At the end of his row, the total is four. The word ELIGIBLE is beside it. It means he can take the final tasks.

For a moment, he feels so happy. He forgets the last practice. He can still get one of the two chairs. His hand moves toward the wall, but he does not touch the paper.

Then he looks at the fourth box again.

It was the wet-day plan. Leo sat beside him. Leo found the line about the desk.

Miss Wu opens the reading room door. She carries the folders with the original pages inside.

“Please check your own record,” she says. “I made the table from your papers. Tell me about any missing or wrong mark before next Monday's final check.”

A girl asks about a mark in her second box. Miss Wu takes her folder to the desk. They begin to compare the page and the record.

Ronan takes his own folder. He finds the fourth page near the middle. Its bottom edge is still folded under. He sees the good answer at the top. He does not open the fold.

Leo comes to the wall. Leo has five good marks for work without help. He puts a finger under his own total and gives a little nod.

“Did you check yours?” he asks.

“I am looking.”

Ronan puts the folder against his chest. Leo moves aside for Mei. She reads her row and then checks the times for the final tasks.

Miss Wu calls the girl back to the desk. Her missing mark is on the original paper. The teacher corrects the record in front of her.

Ronan watches the pencil make one clear change.

The bell rings. He has to go to his next lesson. He puts his folder in his bag and follows the others.

In the classroom, he opens his exercise book. The numbers on the board look ordinary. He copies the first two, then writes four in the wrong place.

He rubs it out. The paper grows grey under his hand.

At lunch, he returns to the reading room wall. His name still has four marks. He reads the word beside it once more. Then he steps away before Leo comes around the corner. His folder stays shut inside his bag.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

eligible＝符合资格的；total＝总数；compare＝比较、对照；rub out＝擦掉。

## 理解问题

1. 记录表上哪一次练习被错误计入独立合格？
2. Miss Wu给所有学生什么核对和更正机会？

## 读句子

**He does not open the fold.**

拆开看：He / does not open / the fold.

他／没有打开／折起的部分。
